events.title: 34th Annual First Bank & Trust Parade of Lights
events.addr: Phillips Ave, 13th St to 5th St, Sioux Falls, SD 57104
events.blurb: Lighted floats roll north on Phillips Avenue from 13th Street to 5th Street. It starts at 6 p.m. this year, an hour earlier than before.
events.blurbEs: Carrozas iluminadas recorren Phillips Avenue hacia el norte, de la calle 13 a la calle 5. Este año empieza a las 6 p.m., una hora antes que en años anteriores.
events.getThere: Free or paid parking in nearby downtown ramps and lots.

events.title: Winter Wonderland at Falls Park
events.addr: 131 E Falls Park Dr, Sioux Falls, SD 57104
events.blurb: The falls and park are lit up with holiday lights and music every night from 5 p.m. to midnight, through January 3.
events.blurbEs: Las cascadas y el parque se iluminan con luces y música navideña cada noche de 5 p.m. a medianoche, hasta el 3 de enero.

events.title: El Riad Feztival of Trees
events.addr: 510 S Phillips Ave, Sioux Falls, SD 57104
events.blurb: The El Riad Shriners' holiday tree festival downtown, open 11 a.m. to 10 p.m. Friday and Saturday.
events.blurbEs: El festival de árboles navideños de los El Riad Shriners en el centro, abierto de 11 a.m. a 10 p.m. el viernes y el sábado.

events.title: Steve Payne and Friends: Home for the Holidays
events.addr: 301 S Main Ave, Sioux Falls, SD 57104
events.blurb: Guitarist Steve Payne hosts local musicians and singers for one night of classic, contemporary and holiday music in the Belbas Theater.
events.blurbEs: El guitarrista Steve Payne reúne a músicos y cantantes locales en una sola noche de música clásica, contemporánea y navideña en el Belbas Theater.

events.title: Christmas with Lorie Line 2026
events.addr: 301 S Main Ave, Sioux Falls, SD 57104
events.blurb: Pianist Lorie Line brings her annual Christmas concert to the Washington Pavilion on Sunday.
events.blurbEs: La pianista Lorie Line trae su concierto navideño anual al Washington Pavilion el domingo.

events.title: Sioux Falls Stampede vs. Lincoln Stars
events.addr: 1201 N West Ave, Sioux Falls, SD 57104
events.blurb: The defending Clark Cup champions host Lincoln in USHL hockey on Thanksgiving Saturday.
events.blurbEs: Los actuales campeones de la Clark Cup reciben a Lincoln en hockey de la USHL el sábado de Acción de Gracias.

events.title: Minnesota vs. California
events.addr: 2131 S Minnesota Ave, Sioux Falls, SD 57105
events.blurb: Big Ten meets ACC: the Minnesota Golden Gophers play the California Golden Bears in men's college basketball.
events.blurbEs: Los Minnesota Golden Gophers enfrentan a los California Golden Bears en baloncesto universitario masculino.

events.title: Sioux Falls Skyforce vs. Wisconsin Herd
events.addr: 2131 S Minnesota Ave, Sioux Falls, SD 57105
events.blurb: NBA G League basketball, with games Friday and Sunday. Check the team site for tip-off times.
events.blurbEs: Baloncesto de la NBA G League, con partidos el viernes y el domingo. Consulta el horario en el sitio del equipo.
